incline.note: Lowered reject incline; fixed support bases and frame remain north of the reserved hooklift exchange envelope. Cleats/traction/containment/structure remain to be qualified.

container.capacity_status: Nominal family/class reference only. Rendered envelope is not a volume or payload proof. Exact OEM total envelope, usable volume, body mass, hook interface and permissible load remain unselected.
container.reference_basis: Manufacturer family lists 6m platform, 750mm body height, 2350mm width and nominal 10m3. Ground-frame/body placement and 1570mm hook-mast envelope here are planning assumptions, not a qualified exact SKU.
container.payload_control: Stop at the lower of permitted mass or fill limit; obtain scale/load sensing and selected vehicle/body load limits. Dense brick rubble can be weight-limited before volume is full.
container.material_destination: Segregated fired-brick rejects for controlled recycling: crushed return as qualified recipe additive or aggregate. Not an assumption of landfill disposal.

reject_system.qualification: Static reject service proposal only. Motion, hooklift swept paths, structure, swing drive, impact, dust handling and live interlocks require implementation and validation.

swing_away_discharge.type: Rigid horizontal swing-away conveyor head; static fill and stowed review states
swing_away_discharge.support_rule: Head pivots west on an engineered cantilever. No feet or fixed structure inside the body or reserved exchange envelope.
swing_away_discharge.impact_dust_note: Impact liner, enclosed transfer hood and dust capture require supplier design; the 1.6m empty-floor drop is not a validated acceptable brick impact. No rigid low chute shown inside body.
swing_away_discharge.interlock: Only fill when body located, fill/load limits valid and exchange gate closed. Stop and clear feed, lift head 0.5m and prove raised before swinging west; prove west-stowed before pickup. After exchange swing raised head back to longitudinal fill pose, then lower and prove before restart.
swing_away_discharge.qualification: Concept lift mast, pivot, cantilever, drive and swept volume remain unqualified; rigid head retains the same physical length in both states.

service.operating_state: Fill: skip installed; head at fill position; exchange zone closed.
service.exchange_state: Feed stopped and belts cleared; head lifted 0.5m then swung west and proved; zone released for hooklift pickup.

lift_exclusion_reservation.status: Illustrative planning reservation, NOT the selected hooklift/skip swept volume or qualified required clearance. Actual vehicle, tilt trajectory and overhead clearance must be checked.

south_approach_reservation.status: Planning-only straight approach; hooklift backs north (-Z), removes skip toward south (+Z). Turning path and staging outside this strip require separate site planning.

service.spare_skip_staging_status: Off-line spare-body position and vehicle turning area not yet selected; do not block frozen storage/spine or dispatch.
exchange_sequence: Stop upstream material release; do not treat routing fields as a buffer.
Clear all reject belts and confirm no falling material.
Lift discharge head 0.5m and prove raised, then swing west and prove stowed; inhibit all collection motion.
Release isolated exchange zone and reverse hooklift truck from south.
Pick up full body with normal combined lifting/tilting/movement; do not assume horizontal-only withdrawal.
Deliver empty body; verify seating, hook/interface, position and permissible load/fill limits; truck exits.
Re-secure zone; swing raised head back to longitudinal fill pose, then lower and prove fill position before restarting upstream release.
service.continuous_operation: No exchange buffer or second receiving position is included. Without one, upstream production pauses during exchange.

adopted_dispatch.driver_access_status: Driver exits/returns under controlled immobilization and forklift exclusion; no pedestrian route through an active loading lane is assumed.
adopted_dispatch.traffic_rule: Immobilize truck while forklifts load; controlled crossings at both bay ends. Both loading sides served from north/south cross connections. No concurrent truck movement across occupied forklift lanes.
adopted_dispatch.lifting_interface: Forklift raises pallet from ground staging to trailer deck; no dock platform. Real load-at-height/centre ratings and task automation remain qualification gates.
adopted_dispatch.operating_assignment: One active side-loading bay plus one flexible/contingency bay; no inferred loading throughput.
adopted_dispatch.staging_status: Exactly16two-sided handoff positions, separate from128frozen storage. Supersedes initial32-position sketch. No runtime capacity/throughput claim; second bay may idle or handle exceptions.

change_summary.reject_service: ISO receiver replaced by removable rubble skip; lowered incline and rigid swing-away head; south exchange reservation.

reject_service_revision.scope: Only reject incline, removable receiver and exchange provision changed; upstream/routing/formation/frozen storage/gantry/access spine/dispatch preserved.

upstream_kiln_cart.change_authorization: User requested north-to-south kiln-cart track west of facility and 90 degree claw/layer rotation during transfer.
upstream_kiln_cart.coordinate_system: X east, Y up, Z south; metres and radians.

track.cart_motion_axis: Z only; no transverse empty-cart shuttle

cart.support_tray_basis: Functional planning support correction: rotated six-stack footprint spans6.98m. A7.2m tray gives0.11m nominal side margin; exact kiln-cart/tray hardware not qualified.

pickup_grid.layer_pick_order: Top down; one complete 40-brick layer per selected stack; every brick retains its unique ID.

layer_claw_transfer.rotation_stage: While lifted and carrying the complete layer during transfer; not a rotation of only the empty claw. Motion feasibility and all-head swept-volume qualification remain assumptions.
layer_claw_transfer.placement_mapping: c chooses one of six group/side rows; j chooses its six existing X positions. Subsequent row extraction, feed and inspection locations stay fixed.

unloading_bridge_planning_bounds.scope: Upstream unloading support only; finished-goods shared-storage gantry remains unchanged. Exact structure and moving-tool interference unqualified.

upstream_kiln_cart.empty_exit_interlock: No cart may be labelled empty or sent to the south empty-cart exit until every brick originally carried by that cart has been removed. A partly consumed cart remains at the unloading station in a bounded run.
upstream_kiln_cart.qualification: Operational planning update; rail/cart/bridge mechanics, claw payload, rotation sweep and simultaneous-head clearance require engineering validation.
